resources.string: What is left to do, checked off as it is done: shopping, tasks, a checklist

Place in the list, 0 at the top, among every item, checked or not. A position already taken puts the item there and moves the following ones down; without a position the item goes last. Positions stay 0, 1, 2… with no gap

When the item was checked; absent while it is not. Unchecking removes it, and when it was checked is forgotten. In a list set to remove what is checked (remove_when_checked), an item is deleted instead of checked
A checked item is removed at once
Whether checking an item deletes it at once, for a list whose done items have nothing left to say (shopping). In such a list, delete an item rather than set its checked_at
